description: Inspect one upload’s availability, expiration, and byte size without reading its contents, running jq, or extending its lifetime. Use before reusing an older upload_id or to check whether deletion or expiration has made it unavailable. To read contents, use process_json with upload_id and filter ".". To remove it, use delete_upload. Pass the exact secret upload_id returned by upload_json or REST POST /uploads. No upload listing is exposed; anyone holding an ID can inspect that one upload. Returns success, available, status (available, missing, or expired), expires_at (UTC), expires_in_seconds, and size_bytes. Missing/deleted and expired uploads return available:false and size_bytes:null as a successful status check; expiration reports zero seconds. Does not consume processing quota or change stored data. Invalid IDs are rejected; a storage failure returns success:false,error,status:503.

upload_id.description: Exact secret upload_id returned by upload_json or POST /uploads; not a filename or URL. Anyone holding it can inspect, query, or delete that upload. Valid for 15 minutes.

name: get_upload
title: Inspect uploaded JSON metadata
